applyUpdateDialog.description: Review which fields will be pulled from the new pack version and which were left alone.
applyUpdateDialog.noBaselineWarning: This clone has no recorded baseline (it predates the v50 schema bump). Applying the update will overwrite every pack-managed field. Duplicate first if you want to keep a backup.
applyUpdateDialog.noChanges: No pack-managed fields differ from your row.

builtInReadOnly: Built-in characters are read-only — duplicate first
description: The character packs agents are cloned from, and knowledge bases any agent can bind. The agents themselves are managed on the Agents page.

account.description: Pin sends from this character to a specific provider account. Inherit uses the session / settings default.
account.label: Account override

advanced.title: Advanced overrides
advanced.description: Per-agent overrides of app-level defaults. Anything left on “Inherit” follows Settings, and a session can still override most of these.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Provider this agent sends through. A session's provider choice still wins.

thinking.label: Extended thinking budget
thinking.description: Tokens for extended thinking (0–64000). Empty inherits the app default; 0 uses the model's own default.

outputStyle.label: Output style
outputStyle.description: How this agent's replies are shaped. “Default” turns off an app-wide style for this agent.
outputStyle.customHint: Used whenever the effective output style is Custom. Leave empty to inherit.

a2ui.label: A2UI surfaces
a2ui.description: Whether this agent may render interactive A2UI surfaces. A session or agent mode can still override it.

a2uiCatalog.label: A2UI catalog
a2uiCatalog.description: Component catalog for surfaces this agent renders without naming one. Overrides the app default; a surface that names its own catalog keeps it.

pluginTools.label: Plugin tools
pluginTools.description: Tools contributed by enabled plugins. Off removes them from this agent's turns.

builtInSkills.label: Built-in skills in app chats
builtInSkills.description: Expose built-in skills (calendar, IM and similar) in desktop chats. Messaging-platform chats always get them.

ocr.label: OCR tool
ocr.description: Text extraction from images. Available by default; Off removes it for this agent.

workspaceConfinement.label: Workspace confinement
workspaceConfinement.description: Confine built-in file and shell tools to the active workspace. A session override still wins.

toolFilter.label: Tool filter
toolFilter.description: Replaces the app-wide tool filter for this agent. A session filter replaces this one in turn.

toolSearch.label: Deferred tool loading
toolSearch.description: Replaces the app-wide deferred-loading policy for this agent.

compaction.title: Conversation compaction
compaction.description: Each field overrides the app setting on its own. Leave a field on Inherit or empty to follow Settings.

instructions.label: Project instruction files
instructions.description: While overridden, these settings replace the app-level instruction-file settings entirely.

sandboxPolicy.label: Sandbox resource ceiling
sandboxPolicy.description: While overridden, replaces the app-level ceiling for this agent. Only applies when the sandbox is enabled.

platformDefaults.title: Bot defaults
platformDefaults.description: How a messaging bot wearing this agent behaves unless the bot or a conversation says otherwise.

mode.label: Reply mode
mode.description: Replaces the bot's default mode. A conversation override still wins.

platformDefaults.triggerDescription: Take over the parts of “when to answer” this agent needs to differ on. A part you take over starts from the standard private-chat profile; the rest keeps following the bot.

parts.storeUnmatched: Decide separately whether to keep unmatched messages

avatarImage.large: Avatar image is large — a smaller image keeps the character data lean.

browserToolsToggle.description: Let this character drive the in-app preview browser (navigate, snapshot, click, type, read console/network). Desktop only.
browserToolsToggle.label: Agent browser tools

allowedToolIds.description: Restrict which registered native Anthropic tools this character can use. Uncheck all to let every registered tool through.
allowedToolIds.empty: No native Anthropic tools registered yet — install the Computer Use plugin to expose computer / bash / text_editor.
allowedToolIds.label: Allowed native tools

chatConsentMode.description: How the in-chat canUseTool modal behaves. Independent of the Rust gate — both can prompt.
chatConsentMode.label: Chat-side prompt behaviour

requireConsent.description: Force every driving Computer Use call to the consent overlay for this character, regardless of Settings → Automation → Permissions. Useful for new characters whose behaviour you're still learning.
requireConsent.label: Always ask before each call

screenOffMode.description: Keep Computer Use working when the monitor is off or asleep (the session must stay unlocked) by routing capture through a bundled virtual display. Requires the virtual-display driver — set it up under Settings → Automation. Off by default.
screenOffMode.label: Screen-off mode (Windows)

computerUseTarget.description: Where this character's computer-use actions run. Pick a configured cua sandbox to run them in an isolated Docker desktop instead of this machine. Manage sandboxes under Settings → Automation → Sandboxes.
computerUseTarget.label: Execution target

computerUseToggle.description: Let this character see and control the desktop through the Computer Use plugin (screenshots, mouse, keyboard). Desktop only.
computerUseToggle.label: Computer use

execution.envDescription: Plain values are stored with the Agent. Secret values are written to the device keyring; only an opaque reference is saved or exported.
execution.envNameDuplicate: Environment variable {name} is defined more than once.
execution.envNameInvalid: {name} is not a valid environment variable name.
execution.envSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved secret
execution.envSecretSaveFailed: Could not save the secret for {name} to the device keyring.
execution.maxTurnsHint: Hard ceiling from 1 to 100 agentic turns per run.
execution.maxTurnsInvalid: Maximum turns must be a whole number from 1 to 100.

editor.knowledgeBasesEmptyHint: No reusable library is bound to this Agent.
editor.knowledgeBasesHint: Bind one or more reusable libraries. Retrieval searches all selected libraries independently.
editor.mcpServersHint: Leave all unselected to mean "use every enabled server".

memoryPolicy.description: Choose which long-term memory actions this Agent may perform and which scopes it may access.
memoryPolicy.globalCeiling: App-wide memory and privacy settings remain the upper bound. This policy can restrict access, but cannot grant access disabled globally or for the current session.
memoryPolicy.title: Memory policy

editor.name: Name

persona.description: Optional tone and personality woven into the system prompt, plus a greeting and starter prompts.
persona.exemplarPromptsHint: One prompt per line — shown as quick-start chips on a new chat.
persona.exemplarPromptsPlaceholder:
Review my pull request
Draft release notes
persona.openingMessagePlaceholder: Hi! What are we working on today?
persona.title: Persona

platforms.description: Restrict this character to specific platforms. Leave all off to show it everywhere.
platforms.title: Available on

editor.pluginSkillsHint: Skills contributed by enabled plugins. They join this character's turns alongside its chat skills.

routing.description: Choose separate targets for planning, execution, and lightweight utility work. Model aliases and Auto are supported by the existing router.
routing.title: Semantic model routing

enable.description: Replace SDK builtins with sandbox_* equivalents for this character.
enable.label: Sandbox Bash / Edit / Write

tier.description: Beats the app-wide default. Inherit defers to Settings → Sandbox.
tier.label: Sandbox tier
tier.cuaDesktopNeedsBoundDesktop: Runs shell and file work inside the bound desktop. Needs a bound machine whose provider carries it, so pick a sandbox connection under Computer Use first.

editor.skillsHint: Order matters — earlier skills are appended first to the system prompt.

twinBinding.enableCitationsHint: Attach formatted citations for the retrieved chunks to the Twin-RAG sources (display only — never changes the prompt).
twinBinding.enableCorrectiveFilterHint: Drop low-relevance retrieved chunks with a heuristic grader before they reach the prompt.
twinBinding.enableHybridHint: Blend BM25 keyword retrieval with the vector search so verbatim names, ids, and file references aren't missed.
twinBinding.enableQueryExpansionHint: Widen recall with synonym expansion (and optional LLM HyDE/step-back when configured in twin runtime settings).
twinBinding.enableRagHint: Retrieve top-K twin chunks at send time and inject them into the system prompt.
twinBinding.enableStyleFewShotHint: Pick representative writing samples from the twin profile for tone matching.
twinBinding.newTwinIdHint: Letters, digits, and underscores. Must be unique across your characters.
twinBinding.unbindBody: The twin's data is preserved — only this character's link to it is removed.
twinBinding.unboundDescription: Link this character to a Digital Twin to inject RAG-retrieved chunks and writing-style few-shots into every send.
twinBinding.embeddingNoCredentials: The twin's embedding provider has no credentials, so twin knowledge is skipped.
twinBinding.embeddingRebuildRequired: The twin's index was built with another model, so twin knowledge is skipped until it is rebuilt in the Workbench.
twinBinding.embeddingHint: Embedding belongs to the twin and is shared by every agent bound to it. Change it in the Workbench.

voice.description: Optional per-character voice for read-aloud. Inherits the global speech settings when left on Inherit.
voice.title: Voice
